mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper uses known AMP membrane-interaction context for lactoferricin-derived peptides, but does not establish a new molecular target or binding mechanism for these derivatives.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Background mechanism context is not promoted to direct mechanism evidence for this article.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary time-kill, MBC, viable-count, and live/dead imaging assays support rapid bactericidal and antibiofilm functional activity against P. aeruginosa, without resolving a molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: source-supported active peptides including LF11-215, LF11-227, LF11-324, DI-MB-LF11-322, and DI-MB-LF11-215

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CLSM source evidence supports biofilm penetration/dead-cell distribution for selected peptides, especially LF11-215 and DI-MB-LF11-322, as imaging context rather than a direct target mechanism.
